tasks.task_4_1a_seeded_selection_and_replayabl: completed: game/disaster_director.gd start_directing(seed) randomizes at <0 or reseeds at >=0 and captures the effective seed; get_replay_record() returns {seed, selection_history} live and retains the finished round across cleanup/rematch resets; one structured DISASTER_REPLAY line per finished match logs seed+history. tasks.task_4_1b_replicated_hazard_variants: completed: bounded variants live in the existing hazard owners and are selected server-side from the seeded director RNG. Meteor CLUSTER (3 scattered strikes in a bounded 5m disc) vs LANE (4 strikes at 5m spacing along a bounded line), each strike keeping the >=1.2s telegraph floor and the whole sequence counting as one solo event (finished/survival record only after the last strike). Flood rise pattern STEADY vs bounded two-stage SURGE (quick swell, short plateau, final push to the same target) and current pattern CALM vs DRIFT with a cardinal direction (props keep their bounded water forces). Tornado path preset index + forward/reverse direction from the map preset list. All replicate with their gameplay parameters through create/apply_presentation_snapshot; same-seed replay reproduces variant+parameters; five rematch cycles clear variant state and effects.
